name: Full-Stack Software Architecture
description: Comprehensive design patterns, clean code principles, modular architecture, and unit testing across Python, TypeScript, Rust, C++, and Go.
rules: Follow strict separation of concerns between business logic, data models, and UI presentation.
Prefer typed data contracts, deterministic error handling, and guard clauses over nested conditionals.
Write self-documenting code with clear variable and function names.

name: 3D Modelling & Mesh Topology
description: Expert guidelines for poly-modeling, non-destructive modifiers, manifold geometry, quad topology, UV unwrapping, and LOD generation for real-time engines.
rules: Ensure all meshes are manifold with consistent face normals and zero non-manifold edges.
Maintain clean edge flow along deformation joints for smooth skeletal deformation.
Optimize UV islands with uniform texel density and minimal distortion.

name: Rigging & Skeletal Animation
description: Inverse Kinematics (IK/FK), bone weight painting, blend shapes, state machines, animation curves, and physics-driven secondary motion.
rules: Set up dual-quaternion skinning to eliminate volume loss at sharp joint bends.
Keep keyframe curves smooth using custom bezier handles with continuous tangents.
Normalize bone weights so no vertex exceeds 4 bone influences for optimal GPU skinning.

name: Procedural World & Environment Building
description: Deterministic seed-based generation, modular asset snapping, terrain heightmaps, volumetric boundaries, and spatial partitioning.
rules: Use reproducible pseudo-random noise functions (Simplex/Perlin) tied to an explicit seed.
Snap modular structural assets to a strict integer coordinate grid to prevent seams.
Implement spatial hashing or BVH for fast collision and visibility tests.

name: Performance & Memory Optimization
description: Low-level cache locality, zero-allocation algorithms, data-oriented design (ECS), SIMD parallelism, and memory leak profiling.
rules: Avoid dynamic memory allocations in high-frequency execution loops; use pre-allocated object pools.
Structure data in contiguous Arrays-of-Structures or Structures-of-Arrays for maximum L1/L2 cache hits.
Profile latency bottlenecks using deterministic hardware timers before introducing complexity.

name: Tooling, Compilers & Automation
description: Build systems, CMake, Cargo, npm scripts, multi-stage pipelines, automated linting, AST inspection, and MCP tool orchestration.
rules: Enforce deterministic reproducible builds with pinned dependencies and lockfiles.
Automate static type verification and linting prior to code commits.
Structure CLI and tool inputs to provide human-readable logs and actionable error codes.
